<div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto">

<table style="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;border-spacing:0;width:100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;8.01.</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Other Events. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On August 11, 2026, Marriott International, Inc. (&#8220;we&#8221;) entered into a Terms Agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, PNC Capital Markets LLC, Truist Securities, Inc., U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc. and the other Underwriters listed on Schedule I thereto (the &#8220;Terms Agreement,&#8221; which incorporates by reference the Underwriting Agreement General Terms and Provisions, dated March&#160;3, 2021 (which we previously filed on March&#160;5, 2021 as Exhibit 1.1 to our Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K))</span> to issue $250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of our 4.875% Series NN Notes due 2029 (the &#8220;Series NN Notes&#8221;) and $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of our 5.650% Series YY Notes due 2036 (the &#8220;Series YY Notes&#8221; and, together with the Series NN Notes, the &#8220;Notes&#8221;). We issued the Notes on August&#160;13, 2026. The Series NN Notes issued pursuant to the Terms Agreement (the&#160;&#8220;New Series NN Notes&#8221;) constitute an additional issuance of, and a single series (the &#8220;Series NN&#8221;) with, the $500&#160;million aggregate principal amount of 4.875% Series NN Notes due 2029 which we issued on February&#160;22, 2024. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Net proceeds of the offering are approximately $1.233&#160;billion, after deducting the underwriting discount and estimated expenses of the offering and excluding accrued interest on the New Series NN Notes from May&#160;15, 2026 through the day before the settlement date, which the purchasers of the New Series NN Notes paid to us at closing. We intend to use the net proceeds from the offering of the Notes for general corporate purposes, which may include working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions, stock repurchases or repayment of outstanding indebtedness. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We will pay interest on the Series NN Notes on May&#160;15 and November&#160;15 of each year, commencing on November&#160;15, 2026 and we will pay interest on the Series YY Notes on March&#160;15 and September&#160;15 of each year, commencing on March&#160;15, 2027. The Series NN Notes will mature on May&#160;15, 2029 and the Series YY Notes will mature on September&#160;15, 2036. We may redeem the Notes, in whole or in part, at our option, under the terms provided in the applicable Form of Note. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We issued the Notes under an indenture dated as of November&#160;16, 1998 with The Bank of New York Mellon, as successor to JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., formerly known as The Chase Manhattan Bank, as trustee (the &#8220;Indenture&#8221;) (which we previously filed as Exhibit 4.1 to our Annual Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">10-K</span> for the fiscal year ended January&#160;1, 1999). The Series NN was established by the Indenture Officers&#8217; Certificate, dated February&#160;22, 2024, pursuant to Section&#160;301 of the Indenture (which we previously filed on February&#160;22, 2024 as Exhibit 4.3 to our Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K).</span> </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In connection with the public offering of the Notes, we filed a Prospectus dated February&#160;13, 2024 and a Prospectus Supplement dated August<span style="font-weight:bold"> </span>11, 2026 with the Securities and Exchange Commission, each of which forms a part of our Registration Statement on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">S-3</span> (Registration <span style="white-space:nowrap">No.&#160;333-277039)</span> (the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;). We are filing the Terms Agreement, the Indenture Officers&#8217; Certificate pursuant to Section&#160;301 of the Indenture establishing the terms of the New Series NN Notes and the Series YY Notes, the Forms of Notes, and a legal opinion of our counsel, Gibson, Dunn&#160;&amp; Crutcher LLP, on the Notes as exhibits to this report for the purpose of incorporating them as exhibits to the Registration Statement. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
